source_documents.title: EMA Temodal product information, current retrieved document
source_documents.role: Explicit safety and monitoring supplement, not a silent substitute for NCCP indication or local policy

source_documents.note: Link17 on current official catalogue points to retained NCCP00342v4 PDF

source_checks.interpretation: Before failures include added-domain and structural expectations; they are not a count of distinct clinical defects.

findings.title: Missing pre-dose hold thresholds
findings.before: Original assessment reduced only at ANC<1.0 or platelets<50, leaving the current ANC1.0–<1.5 and platelet50–<100 range without a relevant restriction.
findings.after: Current pre-dose thresholds ANC<1.5 and platelets<100 now withhold, explicitly attributed to EMA SmPC p7; independent NCCP nadir reductions retained.

findings.title: Current counts and prior nadirs conflated
findings.before: The original low-count rules immediately reduced one level without timing or previous-cycle context.
findings.after: Separate current pre-dose fields and prior-cycle nadirs; recovery does not erase a nadir-triggered next-cycle reduction.

findings.title: No episode, recovery or prior-dose safeguards
findings.before: A one-level reduction could be shown with no previous dose or recovery context and no protection from repeating it.
findings.after: Document prior100/150/200, recovery and episode action; review absent context; fresh reduction at100 has a stop pathway; an already-applied episode is not reduced twice.

findings.title: Starting-dose and escalation inputs did not drive a decision
findings.before: Previously treated/naive status and dose level were recorded as context only.
findings.after: Starting-dose reference separates naive200 from previously treated150; cycle2 increase is a guarded consultant decision; known conflicting nadirs suppress its criterion. No automatic numerical increase.

findings.title: Recurrent duration ambiguity not surfaced
findings.before: Table1 lists cycles2–6 although treatment paragraph continues until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
findings.after: An explicit source conflict preserves open-ended recurrent schedule and flags beyond-cycle6 review; no automatic six-cycle cap.

findings.title: Hepatic exclusion missing
findings.before: Original Child-Pugh A/B andC shared permissive caution output; significant hepatic dysfunction exclusion was not assessed.
findings.after: Significant dysfunction exclusion and Child-PughC conflict review added; A/B remains separate; no invented ALT/bilirubin cutoff.
findings.source: NCCP p1 exclusion vs p3 Table3; EMA pp5–6

findings.title: Dacarbazine allergy and severe myelosuppression missing
findings.before: Generic component hypersensitivity did not explicitly represent dacarbazine; no severe-myelosuppression exclusion flag.

findings.title: HBV positive screening pathway missing
findings.before: Missing-screen and active-reactivation rules existed, but a positive serology before treatment did not trigger liver-specialist review.
findings.after: Positive-serology review added alongside existing screening/reactivation gates.

findings.title: Important SmPC monitoring supplements absent
findings.before: Original assessment did not explain day22 CBC or post-cycle LFT requirements.
findings.after: Source-labelled Day22±48h CBC, weekly until recovery and after-each-cycle LFTs added; baseline glucose/HBV and day1 FBC/renal/LFT retained; no fixed MRI timing invented.

findings.title: Recovery inequality ambiguity
findings.before: EMA minimum pre-dose criteria are inclusive, while weekly recovery monitoring uses strict greater-than values.
findings.after: At exact1.5/100 after a previous reduction-triggering episode, review gate prevents automatic restart interpretation.
findings.source: EMA p7, visually checked original PDF

findings.title: PJP and interaction risk absent
findings.before: Recurrent monotherapy lacked explicit PJP/steroid and interaction-review pathways.
findings.after: Risk-based PJP review distinct from mandatory42-day concurrent-RT prophylaxis; valproate and marrow-suppressive drug review added. Acute-infection hold gates are clearly marked clinical safety interpretations.

findings.title: Incorrect CTCAE grade4 nausea/vomiting choices
findings.before: Original v5 input options offered grade4 nausea and vomiting with fabricated generic grade4 descriptions.
findings.after: Both inputs now stop at grade3; severe symptoms prompt review but do not incorrectly trigger the generic non-haematological discontinuation table, which excludes nausea/vomiting.
findings.source: NCCP p2 exclusion; existing CTCAE v5 standard and EMA p7

findings.title: Male contraception sources differ
findings.before: NCCP says six months after last dose; current EMA says at least three.
findings.after: Both source positions documented; Irish six-month advice retained for team confirmation.

NCCP 00342 Temozolomide Recurrent Therapy v 4 (23 July 2025)

source_conflicts.resolution: The recurrent regimen text continues until progression or unacceptable toxicity; Table 1 lists cycles 2–6. Do not impose a six-cycle cap or present this as the newly diagnosed adjuvant regimen. The consultant confirms intended duration.

sources.document: NCCP 00342 Temozolomide Recurrent Therapy v 4 (23 July 2025)
NCCP 00342 Temozolomide Recurrent Therapy v 4 (23 July 2025)

source_conflicts.resolution: Significant hepatic dysfunction is an NCCP exclusion; Table 3 says no adjustment is expected for Child-Pugh C. Flag the conflict for consultant/pharmacy decision; Child-Pugh C must not yield automatic standard-dose clearance.

Predose criteria use ANC ≥1.5/platelets≥100, but weekly recovery monitoring continues until ANC >1.5/platelets >100. Exact equality after a cytopenic episode requires review; do not infer complete recovery from the predose threshold alone.

sources.document: NCCP 00342 Temozolomide Recurrent Therapy v 4 (23 July 2025)

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP states avoid fathering a child for six months after the last dose; current EMA states at least three months. Retain the Irish six-month advice and flag the source discrepancy for team confirmation.

limitations: Independent consultant oncology and pharmacy review pending; clinical use not authorised.
Browser/consent/patient/PDF integration belongs to the parent release validation and is not claimed by this isolated audit.
No patient-specific calculated dose is provided; even a fully specified reduction is an explicit consultant/pharmacy confirmation pathway.
No undocumented fixed MRI or tumour-marker schedule, six-cycle cap or universal PJP prophylaxis for the five-day recurrent regimen has been invented.
